description: This Java class `KycController` is a REST controller providing endpoints for retrieving and updating passenger KYC (Know Your Customer) status, listing KYC records, and logging audit events within a passenger verification system.

classes.name: KycController
classes.description: REST controller managing KYC status retrieval and updates for passengers.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current KYC status and verification timestamp for a specific passenger.

methods.name: listRecords
methods.description: Lists all KYC records for a specific passenger, ordered by creation time descending.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the KYC status of a passenger, possibly setting verification timestamp, creating a KYC record, and logging the change.
